games.name: 💥 Bomb Tag Survival
games.desc:
👍 Like the game for more updates!

🏆 Bomb Tag Survival is a fun tag minigame. The objective is to pass the bomb and not blow up to stay alive the longest! Earn coins and compete with others on the leaderboards!

🎉 How to play:
- Pass the Bomb by touching someone.
- Avoid having the bomb when the timer runs out, or you'll be eliminated.
- Last one standing wins!
- Tip: The bomber runs faster than everyone else.

⚠️ Cosmetics such as different bombs do not give you an advantage.
⚠️ You do not gain wins in VIP servers.
